The '''Chipped Amphora''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found digging up an [[Artifact Spot]] in [[Pelican Town]]. It also has a chance to appear inside [[Artifact Trove]]s. [[Vincent]] sells one in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|1|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Bundles==
The Chipped Amphora is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Tailoring==
Chipped Amphora is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Antiquity Shirt]].  [[File:Shirt227.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Chipped Amphora is not used in any [[quests]].
